newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Willy Helin said that Commissioner Karel Van Miert invited the Spanish authorities to accept the date of 1 January 1998 for the total liberalisation of telecoms services and therefore renounce any derogation to this date.

Spokeswoman Elisabetta Olivi briefed on Friday's Internal Market Council. She said discussions would focus on the transposition of directives in national legislation, progress of the White Paper on administrative cooperation with Central and Eastern European countries, and transparency in the internal market for information society services.

Spokesman Gerrard Kiely said a study reinforcing the assumption that there is a link between BSE and Creutzfeldt-Jacob disease had been published. Kiely said all measures taken in the Commission since 1989 had been based on this assumption. Kiely also said the report would be sent to the scientific and the multidisciplinary committees and that further action would be taken on their advice.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/950: Europe's free market in air travel has delivered cheaper fares, new airlines and a wider choice of routes, but there is still room for improvement, Commission study finds.
- IP/96/956: The Commission authorises acquisition by Klockner Stahl und Metallhandel GmbH of control of Arus Distribution Industrielle s.a.
- IP/96/957: Commission clears joint venture between Mannesmann and Deutsche Bahn.
- IP/96/958: Liberalisation of telecoms: The Commission stays firm.
- Speech/96/263: Speech by Commissioner Neil Kinnock on the role of research in transport policy.
- Memo/96/100: Single market cannot deliver full benefits without better implementation - Commissioner Monti to caution 25 October Council.
- Memo/96/101: Meda: regional activities and projects - status as of 1st october 1996.
- Communication of the Commission to the Council on the impact of the third package of air transport liberalization measures.
